'''Christoph Stieler''' created [sw-ip], the Star Wars Information Pool, a [[Fan sites|fan site]] with card inventory, quick lookups and rules searches that the [[Players Committee]]'s proofing and design teams used. The Players Committee named [sw-ip] its Partner Site of the Year for Full Year 07 on 7 December 2007.<ref name="pc-sid61">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=61 Full Year 07 - Partner Site of the Year. &#91;sw-ip&#93;], swccgpc.com (7 December 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080617225415/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=61 Internet Archive]</ref>

Stieler earlier worked with g-engine at ccgworkshop on online Star Wars CCG play, programming and helping to design a separate ccgworkshop program for playtesting future [[Virtual cards]]. He also helped create the Online Rules Wiki hosted on the Players Committee website.<ref name="pc-sid61" /> On the Players Committee forum he posted as 10tacle; in October 2008, for [sw-ip], he asked for the data of [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith|Virtual Set 16]], including which cards pull or are pulled by others.<ref name="pcf-23547-342603">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342603#342603 V16 Done], Christoph Stieler (10tacle), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207045348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=355344&sid=da800f192a94d4e0badb0ea8628c4ff7 Internet Archive]</ref>
